<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def left_nodes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c1<32 and n['color']!='c' and n['pixels']>=4:
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
def right_col(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c0>=32 and n['color'] not in ('B','W'):
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
def bigW_right(f):
    c=0
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        if c0>=32 and n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>=20: c+=1
    return c

after_L=left_nodes(current_frame); after_R=right_col(current_frame); after_W=bigW_right(current_frame)
print("AFTER left:",after_L)
print("AFTER right:",after_R,"bigW:",after_W)

def left_nodes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c1<32 and n['color']!='c' and n['pixels']>=4:
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
def right_col(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
        if c0>=32 and n['color'] not in ('B','W'):
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return sorted(out)
def bigW_right(f):
    c=0
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        if c0>=32 and n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>=20: c+=1
    return c
